channel.title: Wire — Releases
channel.description: Releases from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: npm 12 Released: Install Scripts Off by Default as Registry Moves to Explicit Trust
item.description: npm 12 introduces significant security-related changes, making certain installation behaviors opt-in. Notably, script allowances are now off by default, which requires explicit approval for running scripts, including implicit builds. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Vercel Launches v0 API for Headless App Building
item.description: Vercel has made the v0 API generally available, enabling developers and AI agents to programmatically generate, iterate on, preview, and deploy applications through API calls. By Daniel Dominguez (1 source: infoq)

item.title: The SvelteKit 3 Release Candidate is here
item.description: We’ve cleaned out the junk drawer (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: Claude Opus 5 is now available in AWS GovCloud (US)
item.description: AWS GovCloud (US) now offers Claude Opus 5 — the most advanced Opus model yet, and compatible with zero data retention (ZDR) — bringing a step-change in coding, long-running agents, and complex professional work to teams building at the… (1 source: aws)

item.title: Daybreak Red and Daybreak Blue from OpenAI are now available to eligible customers on Amazon Bedrock
item.description: Security teams can now access Daybreak Red and Daybreak Blue from OpenAI on Amazon Bedrock. Both are part of Daybreak, the cyber defense initiative from OpenAI that gives defenders governed access to frontier AI for cybersecurity work. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Billing and Cost Management introduces Managed Dashboards
item.description: AWS Billing and Cost Management (BCM) Dashboards now include Managed Dashboards. These are a collection of preconfigured and read-only dashboards located in your dashboard list. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Rx.NET 7.0 Reduces Deployment Size by Splitting Windows UI Support
item.description: Rx.NET 7.0 has been released with a narrowly focused change aimed at reducing deployment size for Windows applications. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: AWS Client VPN now supports CLI, administration controls, and faster connections
item.description: AWS Client VPN introduces a rebuilt AWS VPN Client v6.0.x which offers new features like command-line interface (CLI) support, enterprise administrative controls, and faster connection establishment time, making it easier you to automate… (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Quick Microsoft 365 extensions are now generally available
item.description: Today, Amazon Quick announces the general availability of Microsoft 365 extensions for Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Spot Placement Score now includes Local Zones
item.description: Today, AWS announces support for AWS Local Zones in Spot placement score, helping you identify locations where your Spot capacity request is most likely to succeed. (1 source: aws)
